name: vanillameta
description: VanillaMeta - open source BI & data visualization platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend-api install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend-web install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend-api run build && npm --prefix frontend-web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend-api run lint && npm --prefix frontend-web run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend-api test && npm --prefix frontend-web test -- --watchAll=false
